notDefects.description: directServer gives its server lifetime context.Background(), so a related check run through it may leave a record retry (bounded at 30 s) or a statistics refresh (only for a project with no statistics, bounded at 10 min) running past the test. This is test-only. Production servers come from register, which refuses a nil lifetime. The focused api tests pass, including under -race. Moving directServer to t.Context() with a retry wait is a test-hygiene change, not a correctness one.
The test cleanup lists the same four waits as waitBackground; one t.Cleanup(served.waitBackground) would do. Duplication only.
The comment names TestTheDeploymentsSuggestionAllowanceIsTheDocumentedBound, which the pull request renamed to TestTheDeploymentsRelatedCheckAllowanceIsTheDocumentedBound. Wording only.
